modpack_browse_no_manifest: No manifest loaded yet. Click Refresh.
modpack_sync_no_subscription: This instance is not linked to any modpack source.
modpack_status_compatible_desc: A release matching the chosen Minecraft version was found and will be downloaded.
modpack_status_pending_desc: The author is actively updating this mod but has not yet shipped a build for the chosen MC version. Skipped this run; you can re-resolve later once they catch up.
modpack_status_abandoned_desc: The author has not updated this mod in over 180 days. Skipped this run; consider an alternative or use an older MC version.
modpack_status_deprecated_desc: The modpack author declares this mod no longer applies to the chosen MC version (usually superseded by a newer feature). Skipped this run.
modpack_status_conflict_desc: This mod declares incompatibility with another mod in the pack and cannot coexist with it.
modpack_status_ambiguous_desc: The mod's version metadata is ambiguous (a known NeoForge field issue); compatibility cannot be reliably determined.
modpack_sync_counts_warn_tip: Pending / Ambiguous: no release yet or undecidable; skipped this run
modpack_sync_counts_deprecated_tip: Deprecated: declared no-longer-applicable on the chosen MC version
modpack_sync_counts_blocked_tip: Abandoned / Conflict: long-unmaintained or incompatible with another mod
modpack_confirm_legend_hint: Hover over a status to see what it means.
modpack_resolving_hint: Fetching pack.json and querying Modrinth/CurseForge for compatible mod versions.
modpack_confirm_summary: Some mods could not be marked Compatible. Review and continue if you accept.
no_log: No log yet. Launch the game first.
welcome_hint:

or click '+ New' to create one.
no_mods_hint: Click "Search Mods" to find and install mods
no_resource_packs_hint: Drop .zip packs into the resourcepacks folder
no_shaders_hint: Drop shader packs into the shaderpacks folder
no_worlds_hint: Launch the game to create one.
author: Author
game_folders_desc: Manage multiple game directories. Switch between them to use different instance sets.
authlib_desc: Login with a Yggdrasil-compatible server (LittleSkin, Blessing Skin, etc.)
cf_no_key: CurseForge API key not configured. Set it in Settings > Data.
theme_desc: Choose a color theme for the launcher.
data_dir_desc: Where game files are stored (instances, libraries, assets).
data_dir_partial: Data directory set (some files could not be moved).
cf_api_key_desc: Optional override. A built-in key is used by default.
java_source_mojang_desc: Mojang's official JRE manifest. Mirrored by BMCLAPI for fast downloads in mainland China.
java_source_bmclapi_desc: Mojang's manifest forced through the BMCLAPI mirror. Use when the Official mirror is slow but you still want Mojang's exact JRE build.
java_source_adoptium_desc: Eclipse Adoptium Temurin (OpenJDK). Java 8/11/17/21/25, JRE preferred, downloaded as a single tarball with SHA-256 verification. Recommended fallback when Mojang/BMCLAPI are unavailable.
java_source_microsoft_desc: Microsoft Build of OpenJDK. Java 11/17/21/25 (no Java 8). Served from Microsoft's CDN. Fast worldwide, JDK only.

ms_signin_desc: Sign in with your Microsoft account.
no_account_to_launch: Please add an account before launching.
up_to_date: All mods are up to date
custom_themes_hint: Place .toml files in <data-dir>/themes/ to add custom themes.
language_hint: Place .json locale files in <data-dir>/locales/ for additional languages.
